WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land,with thebuildings and improvementslocated thereon,in theCountyofNewYork,CityandStateofNewYork,known as and by the street address 122 West 29"h Street, tax lot Block 804, Lot 53 and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafterreferred to as"Owner'sLand";said buildings and improvements,togetherwith any futureadditions,alterations andreplacementsthereofbeinghereinafterreferredtoas"Owner's "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner infee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements located thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 124 West 29"h Street. and the tax lot Block 804, of Lot 54 and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lot being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; WHEREAS, Developer proposes to demolish the existing improvements on Developer's Land together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as (the“New Building"), said Developer's Land and the New Building being hereinafter referred to as "Developer'sProperty"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as"Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time (the"Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained within the Zoning Resolution if Developer's Land was considered as a separate and independent "zoning lot"; WHEREAS, there exists approximately 15,672 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant to the Owner's Land and which are not utilized by the Owner's Building, and Owner desires to make such Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as defined herein) available for use on the Developer's Property and within New Building pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; Asused in this Agreement, the term“Floor Area Development Rights"shall mean the rights,as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop Page 1

such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total “floor area"(as such termisdefinedinSection12-10oftheZoningResolution)determinedby (i)multiplying thearea of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of NewYork (the “City"); and WHEREAS, the Developer desires to acquire and utilize on Developer's Property and within Developer's New Building the Excess Floor Area Development Rights pursuant to the terms and conditions herein and infurtherance thereof Owner andDeveloper shall each execute this Agreement and cause all other parties-in-interest in the Combined Zoning Lot (as herein defined) toeitherexecutetheDeclaration,orwaivetheirrightstodoso,andsubordinatetheirrespective interest in the Combined Zoning Lot to this Agreement:; As used in this Agreement, the term “Excess Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean (i) the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Land as of the date hereof including any and all development rights resulting from a validly enacted amendment of the Zoning Resolution increasing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Land less (i) the Retained Floor Area Development Rights (as defined herein); and WHEREAS, Owner is willing to convey to Developer the Excess Floor Area Development Rights and permit Developer to utilize the Excess Floor Area Development Rights within Developer's New Building on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth for the consideration set forth herein, it being understood and agreed,however, that Owner shall retain for Owner's own benefit all Floor Area Development Rights incorporated into Owner's Building as the same exists on the date hereof (such Floor Area Development Rights being referred to herein as the "Retained Floor Area Development Rights"); and WHEREAS, Owner and Developer shall simultaneouslyupon the execution of this Agreement execute and deliver that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (substantially in the form annexed as Exhibit D to the Amended and Restated Zoning Lot MergerPurchase and Sale AgreementbetweenOwnerandDeveloperdatedSeptember26,2006(Declaration")andall other parties-in-interest in the Combined Zoning Lot (as defined herein) shall waive their right to execute said Declaration, and thereafter, Owner's Property and Developer's Property shall constitute a single zoning lot for the purpose of Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Combined Zoning Lot"); and WHEREAS, as an integral part of this transaction, Owner and Developer shall execute all other relevant documents described herein to effectuate thetransfer of theExcessFloor Area DevelopmentRights;and For the purposes hereof references to “Block", Bulk", “Floor Area", “Zoning Lot”’ and “party in interest", shall have the meanings set forth in the Zoning Resolution.
